From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-quarter leadership readout & targeted rescope asks

Team —

Quick ask ahead of the QBR prep: we need a compact, decision-grade readout for the leadership sync. Keep notes to one page per OKR (status + delta + clear ask). Focus items below — please return a first-pass by COB Monday (11/8).

Top asks:
- One-line health: GREEN / AMBER / RED per objective and 1-2 sentence rationale.
- If AMBER/RED, propose exactly what we need (people, infra, partner deliverables) and the tradeoff (scope or timeline).
- Dependencies we should escalate now (e.g. SOC2 evidence, Dedicated capacity bursts, partner API gating).
- A fallback plan if the dependency slips (what feature is trimmed, how we measure success).

Attached the QBR one-pager template to keep this tight (QBR_one-pager_template.pdf).

Thanks — keep it crisp. Leadership wants to see: problem -> ask -> impact.

— Markus
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership readout & targeted rescope asks

Markus / all —

Sending a first-pass for my pod. I attached the one-pager and a short CSV export of current deliverable health. Below is the TL;DR + explicit asks.

Objective A (Reduce avg inference cost by 18%): AMBER — network/caching gives -10% but quantization work stalled.
- Rationale: quantization PRs blocked by nightly infra instability (kernel mismatch on 4090 fleet).
- Ask: 2 infra SWEs for one sprint (3 wks) to stabilize nightly kernels (+ access to dedicated burst capacity for model evals).
- Fallback: lock to previous quantized artifact and revert new kernels; expected cost savings -8% instead of 18%.

Objective B (Improve latency tail for hosted API): GREEN — recent routing changes dropped p99 by 30ms.
- No immediate asks. Recommend monitoring window for two weeks post-rollout.

Objective C (Enterprise adoption: 3 new Dedicated deals): AMBER — procurement timelines slower from two pilots, one security questionnaire outstanding.
- Ask: help from Security (SOC2 evidence pull) and one Solutions Engineer to lead procurement calls next week.
- Fallback: reclassify one pilot to "self-serve" funnel and push sales cycle to next quarter.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qXr-example-QBR-folder (draft slide + data extract).
Attachments: H_S_OKR_onepager_v1.pdf; QBR_data_extract.csv

I can synthesize into one slide if you want; leaving open for comments.

— Hannah
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — good, level-set detail. A couple quick notes:

- On the infra SWEs: product is priority. I can reassign one SWE from the evaluation team for two weeks (partial allocation) and we can add the second via contractor — will confirm cost by EOD Monday.
- On SOC2 evidence: looping in CS/eng to prioritize the evidence pull. Vanessa, can your team own the SOC2 extract and timeline (ETA 11/12)?
- On Dedicated burst capacity: we can approve a capped burst (50% of requested) while we measure eval throughput. Markus — we need your sign-off on the financial exposure.

I'll also take point on the procurement calls for pilot #2 and offer to run a joint call with solutions eng next Tue/Wed.

— Marissa
Head of Customer Growth
Redwood Inference

- Approve one SWE for infra stabilization (Marissa to confirm source). Second SWE to be contractor — ok to proceed subject to cost guardrail of $25k.
- Approve capped burst capacity at 50% of request for a 2-week evaluation window. Must include measurement plan (throughput, p50/p95 token cost) and stop criteria.
- Vanessa to own SOC2 evidence pull; target 11/12 for the extract. If SOC2 is not available, authorize a short security attestation doc for pilot enablement.

- Hannah: consolidate into single-page readout + explicit runbook for the two-week burst (due 11/9 EOD).

Folks —

Attached is the consolidated one-pager and a short runbook for the 2-week burst: consolidated_runbook_v1.md and H_S_OKR_onepager_v1.pdf (attached). Summary below.

Summary of changes since Friday:
- SWE allocation: Marissa confirmed one full-time SWE from the evaluation team starting 11/10; contractor engagement approved pending PO (expected 11/10).
- Burst capacity: approved at 50% for 11/11–11/24. Measurement plan included in runbook: daily ingest rate, p50/p95 latency, per-token cost delta. Stop criteria: if cost delta > +25% or no >6% reduction in avg cost by week 2.
- SOC2: Vanessa confirmed evidence pull in progress; fallback attestation drafted if full payload is delayed.

Next steps (this week):
1) Marissa — confirm PO cost & contractor on 11/10.
2) Vanessa — finalize SOC2 extract or attestation by 11/12.
3) Hannah — runbook + short slide for leadership, shared to the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qXr-example-QBR-folder).

Patrick / LumenAI: thanks for patience — we will share a short summary of the planned burst and expected impact by Tue morning. If you have constraints on the evaluation window, please flag them.

Attachments: consolidated_runbook_v1.md; H_S_OKR_onepager_v1.pdf; QBR_data_extract.csv
